newsitem.title: USA: Fusion gets FDA ok for collagen patch.
newsitem.headline: Fusion gets FDA ok for collagen patch.

text.p: Fusion Medical Technologies Inc. Tuesday said it received 510(k) clearance from the Food and Drug Administration to market in the United States the company's collagen-based patch for the treatment of bleeding in solid organs, such as the spleen and liver.

In a statement, the company said the thin, collagen-based biodegradable patch is applied by surgeons in order to create a flexible, fluid-tight seal which does not perforate or stress the neighboring tissue. Initial test marketing is scheduled to begin in second quarter 1997 to gain experience in humans.
